connector.name: MCP Einvoicing Be
connector.registryDescription: Belgian e-invoicing MCP server: Peppol BIS 3.0, UBL 2.1, EU PINT v1.0.1, Mercurius.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcp-einvoicing-be. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cmendezs account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: BCE_API_KEY
env.description: API key for the Belgian BCE/KBO enterprise database (optional — public endpoints work without it)

env.name: LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Logging level: DEBUG, INFO (default), WARNING, or ERROR
